Watch and enjoy the romantic melody “Madhurame” video song from the movie “Arjun Reddy”. Featuring Vijay Devarakonda and Shalini Pandey, this track sung by Sameera Bharadwaj and composed by Radhan.
Song: Madhurame
Movie: Arjun Reddy
Banner: Bhadrakali Pictures
Producer: Pranay Reddy Vanga
Director: Sandeep Reddy Vanga
Casting: Vijay Devarakonda, Shalini Pandey
Music: Radhan
